title: part_1_extraction_readme.txt
content:
SPLIT PACKAGE — PART 1 OF 2

Source package: WorldBuilder+LifeSimulation_Enhanced.zip

This archive contains the main program, launch pages, maps, globe systems, data, documentation, and shared assets.

EXTRACTION:
1. Create or choose one empty destination folder.
2. Extract Part 1 into that folder.
3. Extract Part 2 into the SAME folder.
4. Allow folders to merge. No project files are duplicated between the two parts.
5. Open the launch HTML or Windows launcher from the reconstructed WorldBuilder+LifeSimulation folder.

Part 2 contains the matching Visual Studio folder.
